# forumulate_org (Data Source)

The organization the provider is configured for (`org_id` / `FORUMULATE_ORG_ID`): its id, slug, name and base settings.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "forumulate_org" "this" {}

output "org_slug" {
  value = data.forumulate_org.this.slug
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `content_language` (String) The organization's content language, when set.
- `created_at` (String) When the organization was created.
- `id` (String) The organization's id (a UUID).
- `inbound_email_domain` (String) The domain inbound email is received on, when set.
- `name` (String) The organization's name.
- `slug` (String) The organization's slug.
- `trash_retention_days` (Number) How long trashed content is kept, when set.
